title: Arcane Alchemist's Observatory
description: A wizard in a flowing purple robe stands reading an ancient glowing tome before a massive arched marble wall filled with shelves of glowing green potions and magical orbs. In the foreground, a purple-draped table holds an open green chest with gold coins, scattered parchment, candles, and a small glowing vial, while a large golden balance scale hangs centrally with one pan holding flowers.
prompt: A solitary wizard in a long purple hooded robe stands reading a glowing blue tome inside a majestic arcane laboratory. Behind him is a towering arched marble wall with dozens of glowing green potion bottles and crystal orbs arranged symmetrically. A large golden balance scale hangs in the center with flowers on one side. Foreground shows a purple velvet table with an open green treasure chest spilling gold coins, scrolls, and candles. The ceiling is a starry purple night sky with glowing constellations, highly detailed fantasy digital art.
